name: Project command map
summary: Quick checks and full acceptance commands for one repository, confirmed by the user. Offered only when the commands can't be found in standard files or need a Windows form.

evidence.setting: repository context files in general; useful for non-standard practices, overviews unhelpful
evidence.effect: no general gain at over 20% more cost on average; non-discoverable commands count as a non-standard practice (inference)

killTest.hypothesis: A command map shortens the path to a passing check where commands aren't discoverable
killTest.pass: Median turns to the first passing acceptance run lower by at least 1, and wins
killTest.budget: 10 tasks in 3 such repos x 2 arms x 2 runs
killTest.scheduled: v8.0 maintainer reference bench, first run after release

maintenance: Owned template; the commands come from the user's answers.
